chunks: 1781 - And he, peace be upon him, said:

“Whoever fasts for Allah, Mighty and Majestic, for one day in intense heat and is overcome by thirst, Allah appoints for him a thousand angels who wipe his face and give him glad tidings until, when he breaks his fast, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, says: How pleasant are your fragrance and your spirit. O My angels, bear witness that I have indeed forgiven him.”

key_terms.أَفْطَرَ: he broke his fast at the end of the fasting period
key_terms.أَلْفَ مَلَكٍ: a thousand angels appointed in honor of the fasting person
key_terms.شِدَّةِ الْحَرِّ: the intensity of heat and hardship
key_terms.صَامَ: observed fasting for the sake of Allah
key_terms.يُبَشِّرُونَهُ: they give him glad tidings of divine favor

ai.seo_question: What reward is promised for fasting for Allah on an intensely hot day?
ai.summary: This hadith extols the virtue of fasting sincerely for Allah during severe heat and enduring thirst with patience. It describes the divine honor, angelic glad tidings, and forgiveness granted to the fasting person, highlighting the immense spiritual reward of sincere sawm.
